race.comment: QUEEN'S ENGLISH (12) brings the best exposed line, having debuted in the G3 Blue Diamond Preview (Fillies) and now returning to maiden grade with a Mornington trial win behind her. She was beaten just over five lengths there after being slow away, but that level of race gives her a clear reference point for this. AMBER QUEEN (10) is the main unknown as a well-bred first starter for Anthony & Sam Freedman, and a close second in her latest Mornington trial gives her enough readiness to be treated seriously. GATTINO VELOCE (7) has race experience and two trials since last racing, including a close second at Cranbourne. Consistent sort who should be right there fresh. MAGNUSAURUS REX (3) is the race-fit danger, with consecutive seconds and a 4kg claim adding interest.
